src.streamlit_sncf_app¶

To launch the app:

uv sync cd ./ #project’s root uv run streamlit run ./src/streamlit_sncf_app.py

The raw data file “regularite-mensuelle-tgv-aqst.csv” shall be stored in ./data/raw, downloaded from https://ressources.data.sncf.com/explore/dataset/regularite-mensuelle-tgv-aqst/export/
